Beautifly

Bug Flying

Hoenn · Generation 3

Beautifly is a Bug/Flying-type Butterfly Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 28.4 kg. It evolves from Silcoon. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (100), with a base stat total of 395.
